title: Escape from New York: Escape from Chicago #3
desc: FIELD OF BODIES! Showdown in the ruins of Soldiers Field! Maya Torres’ past catches up to Snake at the worst possible moment. Years ago, Maya’s parents smuggled something into Chicago, a device that could change the balance of power between Chicago’s warring gangs. Not just that—it could transform the prison city entirely. The Torres died on the mission, but now Maya’s poked her head above water, and every gun in the city is trained on it. She hired Snake to get her out of Chicago. It was supposed to be an extraction, not a suicide run. If there’s anyone who can get their asses out of the fire, it’s Snake Plissken—but when Maya learns HIS secrets, Snake may have one more enemy too many.
